about:
C & G Custom Woodworks operates from Millbrook, Alabama, as a small custom woodworking shop. The founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed, nor are the founders named in available sources. The business presents itself as a hands-on operation emphasizing craftsmanship and personal attention.

The shop produces architectural millwork, windows, doors, curved mouldings, hardwood flooring, and bar fixtures, with a specialty in historical restoration. It works in exotic woods, heart pine, and mahogany, and employs traditional mortise-and-tenon joinery. No facility size, headcount, or production volumes are published.

The company serves customers seeking custom woodwork and historical restoration, though specific industries or client examples are not disclosed in the available information.

The shop states that its focus on craftsmanship, personal attention, and reasonable pricing sets it apart, aiming to deliver exactly what each customer wants through timeless techniques.
